- API rotation: yes — we support automated rotation via our Admin console. We can set a 30-day rotation policy and seed a set of short-lived API tokens for your CI. Permanent service keys are optional and can be kept only for limited admin tasks.
- Ephemeral pattern: recommend short-lived service accounts + token exchange (we provide a helper script) that issues a 1-hour token for CI runs and refreshes using a signed JWT from your KMS. We'll share the helper later today.
- Invite template: attached (MAP_v1_jonas.pdf) — it includes the invite copy, expected SSO flow, and what end users will see.

Proposed immediate plan (first 7 calendar days):
1) Jan 16 — Redwood seeds 5 admin invites + 3 dev invites for initial access (we'll stagger the rest).
2) Jan 16 — Ben to send the API key seeding script and service account pattern; Monica to send invite templates.
3) Jan 17 — Avery confirms SSO config + returns KMS thumbprint.
4) Jan 18 — We perform a short smoke test for auth and a single generate call; report back.

If that schedule works, we'll mark the ticket and Ben will start the seed this afternoon.
